events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey board files, probes and github references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/*.mjs | head -30; ls workshop-plan/tasks | head -40; ls cloud | head; grep -c "github" workshop-plan/tasks.html workshop-plan/tasks/*.py 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -5 -- workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find remaining GitHub references in board, Worker and task scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i "github" workshop-plan/tasks.html workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py workshop-plan/tasks/runner.py workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py workshop-plan/tasks/overflow.py | cut -c1-260; ls cloud/board; wc -l cloud/board/* 2>/dev/null | tail -8; grep -n -i "github" cloud/board/*.js cloud/board/*.toml 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-220 | head -30; tail -5 workshop-plan/tasks/github-poll.log | cut -c1-200; tail -4 workshop-plan/tasks/board-sync.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the stale GitHub mentions in board page, pass.py and runner.py
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 770,800p workshop-plan/tasks.html | cut -c1-400; echo ----; sed -n 205,226p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py; sed -n 338,346p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py; sed -n 628,640p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py; echo ----; sed -n 8,18p workshop-plan/tasks/runner.py; sed -n 800,808p workshop-plan/tasks/runner.py; echo; grep -n "window.open\|target=._blank\|issues/new" workshop-plan/tasks.html | cut -c1-200 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the live public board probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; date; node workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs --live > /tmp/t322-pub.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c -i "^ *ok\|✓" /tmp/t322-pub.log; grep -i -n "fail\|✗\|error" /tmp/t322-pub.log | head -20; tail -4 /tmp/t322-pub.log | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the live public board probe from workshop-plan
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; date; node probe-public-board.mjs --live > /tmp/t322-pub.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; date; wc -l /tmp/t322-pub.log; grep -i -n "fail\|✗\|not ok" /tmp/t322-pub.log | head -20; head -5 /tmp/t322-pub.log | cut -c1-200; tail -4 /tmp/t322-pub.log | cut -c1-300
